sources.title: The Smol Training Playbook - a Hugging Face Space by HuggingFaceTB
sources.snippet: You'll see how promising small-scale ablations sometimes don't translate at scale; why we restarted a training run after 1T tokens; how we balanced the competing objectives of multilinguality, math, and code while maintaining strong English-language performance; and finally how we post-trained a hybrid reasoning model.

sources.title: GitHub - huggingface/smol-course: A course on aligning smol models ...
sources.snippet: a smol course This is a practical course on aligning language models for your specific use case. It's a handy way to get started with aligning language models, because everything runs on most local machines. There are minimal GPU requirements and no paid services.
